<template>
  <el-dialog
      v-model="visible"
      title="查看防火墙规则"
      width="600px"
      @close="rules = []"
  >
    <!-- 容器下拉选择 -->
    <el-form :inline="true" class="mb-4">
      <el-form-item label="容器名称">
        <el-select v-model="containerName" placeholder="选择容器" style="width: 240px">
          <el-option
              v-for="container in containerList"
              :key="container.Id"
              :label="container.Names?.[0] || container.Id"
              :value="container.Names?.[0] || container.Id"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item label="链名称">
        <el-select v-model="chain" placeholder="选择链" style="width: 160px">
          <el-option label="INPUT" value="INPUT" />
          <el-option label="OUTPUT" value="OUTPUT" />
          <el-option label="FORWARD" value="FORWARD" />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>

      <el-form-item>
        <el-button type="primary" @click="handleViewRules">查看</el-button>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <!-- 表格展示 -->
    <el-table :data="rules" v-loading="loading" style="width: 100%">
      <el-table-column prop="index" label="#" width="50" />
      <el-table-column prop="content" label="规则内容" />
    </el-table>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="visible = false">关闭</el-button>
    </template>

    <!-- 容器数据来源组件（不展示） -->
    <DockerContainers ref="dockerRef" style="display: none" />
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose, onMounted } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'
import DockerContainers from '@/components/Container/DockerContainers.vue'

const visible = ref(false)
const containerName = ref('')
const chain = ref('INPUT')
const rules = ref([])
const loading = ref(false)
const containerList = ref([])

const dockerRef = ref(null)

// 弹窗打开时加载容器数据
const openDialog = async () => {
  visible.value = true
  if (dockerRef.value?.fetchContainers) {
    await dockerRef.value.fetchContainers()
    containerList.value = dockerRef.value.containers
  }
}
defineExpose({ openDialog })

// 查看规则逻辑
const handleViewRules = async () => {
  if (!containerName.value) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择容器')
    return
  }

  loading.value = true
  try {
    const response = await axios.get('http://localhost:8081/firewall/list', {
      params: {
        containerName: containerName.value,
        chain: chain.value,
      },
    })

    const lines = response.data.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim() !== '')
    rules.value = lines.map((line, index) => ({
      index: index + 1,
      content: line,
    }))
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error(`获取规则失败：${err?.response?.data || err.message}`)
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.mb-4 {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
</style>
